Jakob Riis is a data manager at the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP) and a member of the steering group for DANIBD (The Danish Registry for Inflammatory Bowel Disease) [^src1]. In this capacity, he holds technical and operational responsibility for data collection, data quality, and reporting within the national IBD registry [^src1]. 

His work is part of a broader national initiative in Denmark to systematize and improve the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease through cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and evidence-based development of treatment guidelines [^src1]. As a member of the DANIBD steering group, which serves as the strategic management unit for the registry, Riis contributes to the oversight of clinical benchmarking, evaluation of treatment access, and the implementation of quality indicators based on detailed quality data from the reporting period of October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023 [^src1].
